scenario: NFP four hours ahead, coherent core edge, generous safe window
expected: CLEAR_WITH_CONSTRAINTS; event existence alone cannot veto; expire before adaptive pre-hazard boundary.

scenario: NFP twenty minutes ahead, M1 time-to-exploit telemetry suggests most triggers occur later
expected: HOLD or VETO depending safety buffer; no Active merely because core thesis is strong.

scenario: High-impact event date confirmed but official release time TBD
expected: Preserve TBD_TIME; do not invent timestamp; material uncertainty prevents exact clearance if relevant.

scenario: Treasury tentative schedule later revised
expected: Live uses latest official schedule; historical review uses only version known then.

scenario: Month-end WMR exists but no sourced flow sign
expected: Clock may constrain/review; no bullish/bearish temporal force.

scenario: Month-end WMR plus asset-manager hedge are same root mechanism
expected: Dependency graph prevents double-counting.

scenario: Quarter-end with current funding/basis evidence unavailable
expected: Do not assume stress; clock present but mechanism materiality capped.

scenario: Quarter-end with documented funding constraint relevant to EURUSD
expected: May HOLD/VETO or apply opposing temporal force; mechanism/source explicit.

scenario: Nasdaq quarterly expiry + SOQ + cash open
expected: Treat linked stages as one root expiry/settlement mechanism.

scenario: SPX PM-settled option confused with AM-settled index series
expected: Fail product/series resolution; no generic OpEx clearance.

scenario: Daily/weekly option expiry on holiday-adjusted date
expected: Use current official expiration calendar; do not rely on static weekday rule.

scenario: NQ CFD open while Nasdaq cash market not yet open
expected: Separate broker execution availability from reference cash clock.

scenario: CFD maintenance closed while reference futures open
expected: CLOSED/VETO for actual executor despite reference market availability.

scenario: US holiday while London FX and gold markets open
expected: Do not mark global closure; record asymmetric participation.

scenario: DST mismatch week
expected: Use IANA zones/current rules; no fixed UTC offset.

scenario: Tokyo/London handoff without any material scheduled event
expected: Session transition alone is not veto; at most EARLY_REVIEW/HOLD if thesis depends on participant handoff.

scenario: London open on EURUSD with no other clock
expected: No directional timing sign and no Active upgrade from weak core state.

scenario: Friday afternoon with no specific obligation/reset
expected: No automatic no-trade rule.

scenario: Year-end thin calendar but target venue fully open
expected: No veto from label alone; use structural closure/settlement facts.

scenario: LBMA PM auction collides with US macro release
expected: Build collision graph, rank root mechanisms, do not add arbitrary scores.

scenario: WMR 4pm benchmark during coherent EURUSD core candidate
expected: Benchmark is a real clock; direction remains undetermined absent sourced flow sign.

scenario: Treasury auction and unrelated megacap earnings at similar time
expected: Can remain independent clocks; rank by target linkage.

scenario: FOMC statement then press conference
expected: Sequential information stages; validity may expire between stages.

scenario: BoJ meeting official time undecided
expected: Preserve time uncertainty and avoid false precision.

scenario: Unscheduled policy shock
expected: Record detection time; no retroactive schedule before public information.

scenario: Core state BIAS_ONLY and Timing CLEAR
expected: Final remains BIAS_ONLY; Timing cannot upgrade.

scenario: Core NO_EDGE and Timing FAVORABLE/clear
expected: Final remains NO_EDGE.

scenario: Core active candidate and Timing HOLD
expected: Final EDGE_CONDITIONAL, NO_TRADE, Why Not Active names timing blocker.

scenario: Core active candidate and Timing CLEAR_WITH_CONSTRAINTS
expected: Final EDGE_ACTIVE with valid_until before hazard.

scenario: Core active candidate and Timing VETO
expected: NO_TRADE; thesis may remain valid internally.

scenario: Material timing source stale
expected: UNDETERMINED_MATERIAL or HOLD; cannot silently clear.

scenario: Material clock primary source unavailable but current secondary corroboration exists
expected: May use capped evidence only if not critical; disclose source tier.

scenario: Permission generated close to expiry, transport delay consumes remaining window
expected: Stale/expired permission becomes NO_TRADE; latency cannot extend TTL.

scenario: Next required review at 15:30, scheduler cannot run until 16:00
expected: Expire permission before 15:30 or HOLD; do not claim continuous monitoring.

scenario: No empirical time-to-trigger sample but safe window several hours with no hard hazard
expected: QUALITATIVE_SAFE_MARGIN allowed with confidence cap; avoid cold-start starvation.

scenario: No empirical sample and safe window marginal
expected: HOLD; no optimistic clearance.

scenario: Large move after timing-vetoed NO_TRADE
expected: Do not label over-veto unless evidence available then justified a clear safe window.

scenario: Timing filter blocks 95% of core active candidates
expected: Flag starvation/model-risk; compare CORE_ONLY control.

scenario: Technical indicator says trend is strong during timing review
expected: Ignore; technical signal has zero timing authority.

scenario: Price/volume spike around expiry with no known clock mechanism
expected: Cannot manufacture timing direction from price response.

scenario: Historical backtest uses current holiday/calendar rule not known then
expected: Fail point-in-time calendar versioning.

scenario: Two clock timestamps close but one is child of the other and one independent
expected: Collapse linked pair, keep independent root; dominance by mechanism not count.
